name: momentum_exhaustion_vix_reversal
mechanism: On NIFTY, a sharp vertical price move (RSI(6) reaching extreme levels in 30 seconds) accompanied by a volume surge >3x the 10-minute baseline while VIX is simultaneously rising signals that directional flow is hitting absorption. Market makers and delta-hedgers who are short gamma from recent option sales begin reversing their hedges within 1-3 bars as the move stalls, creating an immediate mean reversion impulse. The first confirming bar — price ticking in the reversal direction — is the entry trigger; the reversal typically recovers 15-20 NIFTY spot points within 60-90 seconds as systematic stop-orders finish executing and resting limit orders on the other side absorb remaining flow.
core_signal_oneliner: Ultra-short RSI(6) at extreme (oversold/overbought) combined with volume climax (3x baseline) and rising VIX slope, confirmed by first price tick in reversal direction
